title: Studio Automations: a flow copy opened by "New similar" reads "Status: Unpublished draft" although it is stored live, until the page is reloaded
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33048 · automation.package-flow-override · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction (stock showcase @ ee9ad834, admin; seen twice)
1. `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations`, open a packaged flow, choose New similar, give a name, create.
2. The copy opens; its header meta reads "Status: Unpublished draft".
3. Server truth: `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME?state=draft` → 404 (no draft; the copy is stored live) and `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` already holds its row (`enabled: false`).
4. Reload: the header reads "Status: Switched off".

Expected: the header reads the copy's runtime state ("Switched off") as soon as it opens.

Mechanism (from source, not instrumented): `deriveFlowRunStatus` returns `unpublished` when the pillar's loaded `_status` snapshot has no row for the flow, and the pillar does not re-read `_status` after `onFlowCopied`. Low severity (wording until reload).
